basic_profile.bio: Hi! I'm a 23-year-old college student majoring in graphic design based in Portland, Oregon. I recently got into gaming and love playing Animal Crossing during my downtime. I'm also trying to make some extra cash by selling vintage clothes on Depop. I enjoy exploring different diets and have been trying the Warrior Diet for a couple of months now. I'm usually online late at night, especially during weekends. Currently single and enjoying the freedom it brings!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm new to the gaming world but have quickly picked up tips from friends and online communities. My interest in vintage fashion has led me to learn about different eras and styles, often through online resources and forums. The Warrior Diet is something I stumbled upon while researching intermittent fasting, and I'm learning as I experiment with it.
